summary: This is the stage REWRITE_READ section 3 asked for before L=8 could return: an attention-only L=8 cluster kernel plus a per-phase timing print, gated per band against FA3. It should wait for the in-flight stack-streamk-ticket-cluster-c16-c4 and build on that branch, so its decode rows do not carry the known C=8 loss. It must restore the L=8 code that stage 2 deleted, and it must apply the per-query causal mask to the 8 in-cache block keys.
justification: Mechanism: stage 1 L=8 paid ~13 us over L=1 at B=1 (23.2 vs 10.0), a fixed chain rather than bandwidth. Moving the q norm/RoPE/fp8 prologue and the last-rank new-key build (and its pre-gather barrier.cluster) out to master's _pre_attention_kernel removes two named serial suspects. The phase print then attributes the rest (per-tile V widen and 64-row mma.sync, DSMEM reduce-scatter over 128 rows x C). The incumbent is sliding verify_1 FA3 7.6 + combine 3.9 + prepare 1.7 + norm-gate ~1.1 = ~14.3 us, and the M2 target of <=11 us is plausible only if most of the 13 us was prologue and barrier. WEAKEST LINK: at B=16/32, stage 1 lost 1.8x/2.1x, which scales with work rather than a fixed chain. REWRITE_READ sections 2 and 3 and LESSONS say 64-row tiles on mma.sync are MMA-bound, and removing the prologue does not change that, so expect the gate to keep FA3 at 2..16 and 17..32 and the stage to be judged on verify_1 plus the phase print. That is acceptable for a rewrite stage: the per-band gate makes non-wins flat, and the phase print is the stated deliverable. Base mismatch: the change says to build on the stage-2 branch with decode bands 'exactly as stage 2'. Stage 2 runs C=8 at B=2..16, the measured +5.7% sliding decode_16 loss, so every decode row is confounded against master. stack-streamk-ticket-cluster-c16-c4 (in flight) is exactly 'stage 2 with C=8 off, rebased on the stream-K master', so build on it.
confounders: sliding-cluster-s2-decode-c4-pdl-inproc (not landed; the base branch): its decode bands (C=16 B=1, C=8 B=2..16, C=4 B=17..32) change all three sliding decode rows vs master, including a real +5.7% at decode_16. Built on raw s2, the headline mixes a known decode loss with the verify change. Base on stack-streamk-ticket-cluster-c16-c4 once it reports, and read the verify rows against FA3 rows from the same run.

fused-preattention-triton (landed): _pre_attention_kernel becomes the verify prologue (ROPE on, PAIRED=False). Its sliding verify cost (2.7/4.1 us at verify_16/32) is outside both columns, by design, as in the sk-pseudo rewrite. Keep pre-attn excluded from both sides of the prepare timing as written.

sliding-verify-sk-pseudo-decode-s1 (queued, same rows): it targets the same sliding verify_1/16/32 rows through the stream-K decode kernel. Each run is attributable on its own because both leave the other path on FA3, but the two must never be stacked. The winner per band is decided by comparing their printed prepare timings against the same FA3 path.
interference: No companion. The per-band hard gate (>=5% vs FA3, printed) plus PATH CHOSEN makes each verify row attributable to either the cluster kernel or FA3. Using the stack branch as the base removes the only cross-row confound, the decode C=8 band. A revert companion would add nothing that the gate and the phase print do not already give.
rules_flags: CAUSAL MASK on in-cache block keys (must fix in build): stage 1 attended the 8 new keys from registers with i<=j. They are now read from cache 'like every other key', so the gathered range must be [max(0, seq_lens[b]-(W-1)), seq_lens[b]+8), i.e. W+7 keys. Each query row j at position p=seq_lens[b]+j must then mask keys to p-(W-1) <= t <= p. That gives exactly W keys per row (the reference's keys[max(0,p-W+1):p+1]), with the upper (causal) edge on the last tile and the lower edge on the first. Without the upper edge, row j sees future draft tokens.

The L=8 template must exist: stage 2's patch deleted setup_one<8>/launch<8> (VERIFY OFF). Port the L=8 instantiation from stage 1 (hyp/muse_attention_decode/sliding-cuda-cluster-dsmem-onelaunch, impl 593859d), then make it attention-only. Do not assume it is on the s2 branch.
Query precision: the kernel now consumes _pre_attention_kernel's FP8 E4M3 q, which is allowed (no coarser than E4M3). KV stays FP8.
Phase-timing (globaltimer) instantiation is prepare-only. It must not be the instantiation captured in kernel_fn, and no timing buffer may be read inside kernel_fn.
In-process only (no child process); the change already says so. Make sure the stage-2 branch's prepare carries no leftover subprocess path.
open_questions: BUILDER: dispatch after stack-streamk-ticket-cluster-c16-c4 (195dcc1209b6457b) reports, and base on its branch rather than raw s2. If the stack failed, base on s2 with the C=8 band gated off (B=2..16 -> master Triton) so decode rows equal master.
BUILDER: print the phase medians for B=1 at C=16 and for B=16/32 at the chosen C, as absolute us per phase. The kill rule (>=14 us at B=1) should name which phase holds the time.
The gate compares against 'FA3 path minus pre-attn'. Use the same q buffer and pre-attn output for both sides so the cluster kernel is not credited with work done once.
